classificationLegend.A_STATIC_CONTRACT: Resolved as a static architecture contract in this package.
classificationLegend.B_PRODUCTION_IMPLEMENTATION: Requires a later authorized production search change and implementation evidence.
classificationLegend.C_USER_PRODUCT_DECISION: Requires the user to choose ranking, grouping, or presentation behavior.
classificationLegend.D_RUNTIME_DEVICE: Requires real-device/runtime ANR, timing, Compose restoration, or server-path evidence.

rows.userPromise: The search box searches the normalized text the user sees.
rows.observable: NFKC, collapsed whitespace, no blank request; committed query remains visible.

rows.userPromise: ALL, VIDEO, MUSIC, and BOOK isolate results without clearing the query.
rows.operation: Switch scope with a nonblank query
rows.observable: Query preserved; incompatible old rows disappear; new scope request uses the new generation.

rows.userPromise: Cache and stale checks distinguish requests by the full behavior shape.
rows.operation: Search the same text in different scope/page/sort shapes
rows.observable: queryShapeSha256 differs for each scope and any behavioral field change.

rows.userPromise: Loading is visible and never appears as empty or failed.
rows.observable: LOADING before settlement; previous incompatible rows are not labeled as the new query.

rows.userPromise: A true zero-result search is empty, not an error.
rows.operation: Receive HTTP 200 with zero items after every source succeeds
rows.observable: EMPTY state with query and scope retained.

rows.userPromise: Failure, timeout, permission, and authentication are distinguishable and retryable where allowed.
rows.observable: ERROR with specific errorKind; query and scope retained; retry creates a new generation.

rows.userPromise: Offline and stale are visible and are never translated into confirmed empty.
rows.operation: Open/submit offline with and without matching cache
rows.observable: OFFLINE_STALE or OFFLINE_NO_CACHE; only matching namespace/query shape may be shown stale.

rows.userPromise: Old responses cannot overwrite a newer scope or query.
rows.operation: Rapid query/scope changes, deadline expiry, retry
rows.observable: Only exact namespace + generation + requestId + queryShape response commits; stale callbacks are no-op.

rows.userPromise: Same-title items across media domains remain distinct while true duplicates fold.
rows.operation: Render Movie/Audio/Book with the same title and duplicate server rows
rows.observable: Three cross-domain rows survive; duplicate stable identities fold; unknown provenance never merges.

rows.userPromise: Results keep a deterministic order within the active scope.
rows.operation: Receive rows in different callback order
rows.observable: SortName then type/stable-identity tie-break; overlays do not move rows.

rows.userPromise: Returning from detail restores the search context and anchors.
rows.operation: Open detail and navigate back; optionally recreate process
rows.observable: Query/scope restored; same result binding reused; scroll anchor and valid selection restored.

rows.userPromise: Search input and rendering do not recreate the historical 5-second Input timeout or ANR.
rows.entry: SearchRoute under slow network and large result set
rows.operation: Type, submit, switch scope, scroll, open/back, go offline
rows.observable: No ANR, Input timeout, 5-second Main blocking, or NetworkOnMainThreadException.

rows.userPromise: A later implementation can consume one explicit route-state contract.
rows.operation: Implement pagination, cancellation, error mapping, restore
rows.observable: No second ad hoc state model; fixture and mutation gate remain applicable.

notClaimed: No real server, device, or APK path was executed.
Historical ANR P1 is not closed.
User-selected ranking or presentation is not approved.
